The '''Chieftain's gaderffii''', otherwise known as the '''Chieftain's gaffi stick''', was the [[Gaderffii/Legends|weapon]] wielded by the [[Sand People chieftain|chieftain]] of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
As with all other gaderffii, the chieftain's gaderffii had a slightly more ornate appearance and better construction.<ref name="kotor" />

The chieftain's gaderffii was a very prized possession to the chieftain; however, when [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his party arrived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and provided the Sand People with the [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] needed to move camp, the chieftain was willing to give it up to Revan as a sign of gratitude before leaving.
